title: No provider-kind abstraction: routing/request-shaping was provider-string based; kind never consulted
body: BI-0193: unify direct/aggregator/self-host handling so the multimodal + standards epics can build on it.

rcca.root_cause: Providers were added incrementally as strings; kind existed only as metadata in credentials and was never used for shaping/routing.
rcca.corrective: core/provider_kinds.py (kinds/adapters/supports/order_candidates); llm_client annotates candidates with kind + PIPELINE_PREFER_KIND ordering + routes headers/content via adapters.
rcca.preventive: New providers only need a credentials.json entry; kind-aware selection is centralized; tests assert fail-closed supports().
rcca.guideline_ref: EOS: one truth per concern; ADDING-TO-PRODUCT-FORGE
